findings.quote: and attacked, [seizing] a certain gorge that was hard to pass and ringed with cliffs [...]
findings.problem: There is no lacuna. The Greek sentence carries across the chapter break: ἐπιτίθενται, φάραγγά τινα δύσβατον καὶ κρημνώδη | (53.1) περαιουμένων αὐτῶν, 'they attack them while they were crossing a certain gorge, hard to pass and precipitous'. The accusative φάραγγα is the object of περαιουμένων. Nothing in the Greek means 'seizing'; the bracketed verb is made up to fill a gap that is not there. Chapter 53 already renders περαιουμένων ('While they were crossing'), so chapter 52 only needs the attack and the place.
findings.proposed_fix: and attacked them in a certain gorge that was hard to pass and ringed with cliffs [...]

units.note: The closing [...] is kept as the seam marker that runs into 53.1 (περαιουμένων αὐτῶν). Only the invented '[seizing]' is removed.

Last clause 'and rejoined the column' translates καὶ συνάψαι πρὸς τὴν παρεμβολήν, which stands at the start of the Greek of ch. 54 (παρεμβολή = camp). Chapter 54 renders the same clause again; see note there.

The opening '[...] and rejoined the camp.' repeats the clause chapter 53 already renders. It is a seam duplication, not a lacuna or a sense error, so it is left for the apparatus/seam pass. τρί᾽ ἡμιστάδια = 1.5 stades is correct.
